newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev closes firmer amid low dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev closes firmer amid low dollar demand.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 514-518 per dollar, a touch firmer than 517-523 at the opening as dollar supply slightly topped demand in thin interbank volume, dealers said.
"Dollar demand eased probably because of low lev liquidity while supply from both banks and clients was relatively high," one dealer said.
The central bank (BNB) absorbed part of the rise in foreign currency supply, buying small dollar volumes at 515-517 levs in a bid to boost its foreign exchange reserves, traders said.
Central bank's forex reserves fell to $525 million at the end of November from $541 million a month earlier due to its market interventions in support of the lev. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
